speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
text: asked the Minister for National Development whether official translations are made of new place names.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: The approved English and translated names of new streets are then made available on the URA website.

speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
text: One, would the Minister also advise what is the situation regarding translation to Malay and Tamil?

speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
text: Two, would it be possible for the Government to consider setting up a portal whereby members of the public can access this portal to actually have the official names of any street in Chinese, Malay and Tamil?

speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
text: For that matter, there are quite a number of streets where the names are transliterated from Malay and Tamil.

speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
text: So, the need for these different translations did not arise in the past and there was never a need to do an official translation in Malay and Tamil.
